project.name: MakeAiSound
project.type: Android App (Native Kotlin + Jetpack Compose + ONNX Neural TTS)
project.description: Commercial-grade Android offline Text-to-Speech Studio application with VieNeu-TTS v3 Turbo FP32 neural engine, 48kHz WAV audio export, responsive player, telemetry diagnostics, and dark tech OLED UI.

tech_stack.audio_format: 48,000 Hz, 16-bit Mono Lossless PCM RIFF WAV
tech_stack.phonemizer: Rust NDK sea-g2p native libraries (arm64-v8a, armeabi-v7a, x86_64, x86)

architecture_modules.name: engine
architecture_modules.description: Neural inference engine, G2P phonemizer, VieNeu tokenizer, smart text segmentation, emotion tokens, repetition history, and cache tensor pool.

architecture_modules.name: player
architecture_modules.description: Audio player manager with 50ms smooth coroutine polling, MediaPlayer abstraction adapter, waveform sampler, and progress tracker.

architecture_modules.name: storage
architecture_modules.description: Streaming lossless WAV encoder/decoder (RIFF 44-byte header) and MediaStore file storage manager.

architecture_modules.name: ui
architecture_modules.description: Compose Dark OLED Studio theme, Main Studio screen, Voice Selection bottom sheet, scrollbar indicators, waveform visualizer, and diagnostic log bottom sheet.

architecture_modules.name: telemetry
architecture_modules.description: Circular memory log buffer, stage latency breakdowns (G2P, Prefill, Decode, Codec), real-time RTF tracking, and memory profiling.

features: Offline on-device Vietnamese Text-to-Speech synthesis with 8 expressively tuned voice presets.
Full support for inline emotion tags ([chuckle]/[cười], [sigh]/[thở dài], [clear throat]/[hắng giọng]) and <en> English phonetic preservation.
Lossless 48kHz WAV audio export directly to device public Music/MakeAiSound storage with Share Sheet integration.
Full-featured audio studio player with precision seek bar scrubber, dynamic 40-bar waveform visualization, play/pause/replay controls, and 50ms polling.
Circular diagnostic log buffer with real-time RTF (Real-Time Factor) and stage latency metrics.
Custom fluid scrollbar indicators across all scrollable Compose containers.
OLED Dark Tech launcher icon with adaptive, round, and monochrome Material You theming support.

conventions: Keep VieNeu neural inference in FP32 precision with XNNPACK multi-threading for audio fidelity without quantized artifacts.
Manage ONNX OnnxJava OrtSession, OrtEnvironment, and OnnxTensor instances with explicit close() lifecycle calls to avoid native heap leaks.
Retain key/value cache tensor direct float byte buffers inside CacheTensorPool to eliminate per-step GC allocations.
Use streaming chunk-based FileInputStream in WavWriter to prevent 2x heap buffer spikes when reading large WAV files.
